rules.S1: IoT or edge-network target with identifiable L2/L3 identity; document Pi/server role.
rules.S2: Original PCAP/PCAPNG with actual packet clocks; feature CSV alone is insufficient.
rules.S3: Same target has trusted normal observation >=7200 real seconds before evaluation, plus later normal queries; no clock shifting or joining short windows.
rules.S4: Attack against the target with reproducible legal packet labels supported by direction, time interval or official filters; whole-file attack labeling is insufficient.
rules.S5: Network-visible attacks in the threat model; payload-only/physical attacks are out of scope.
rules.S6: No overlap with CICIoT2022 A, UNSW2018 B or admitted history; compare MAC and provenance.

direction_label_evidence: Researcher-reconstructed attack-associated packets are allowed when provenance and direction are established; distinguish these from publisher per-packet payload truth.
inclusion: Evaluate every dataset that passes the registered scope and execution prerequisites; report all outcomes.
